title: Faces of the four Evaluation lists: CLIP ViT-L/14 + LoRA face adapter B3s (wiring only)
role: Loads the saved B3s adapter (facelora_state.pt of datasets/phanvnhtrng/flag2027-feats-ls-b3s-p; no training in this run, the training cell only builds its sampling pool) and embeds the faces of the four Evaluation lists (face_clipB3_<protocol>_<lang>.npy, 768-d); re-extracts the train / MAV-Celeb v1-v2 rows only to check them against the saved arrays, then copies every saved file of the adapter dataset (train / v1 / v2 / VoxCeleb2 / VoxBlink arrays, adapter, bn42_clean.json) into feats_clipb3c_x/. Not in the numbers of the 13.54 zip: e112f0sx scores the B0s head with these faces (English bytes of F0s, recomputed by a_factor) and e112f1sx asserts that exactly one feats_clipb3c_x folder holding bn42_clean.json is attached.

patches.new: ZIP_PREFIXES = ("train_set", "eval", "test")                        # FF dev-exclusion: dev_set.zip is never unpacked (original: ("train_set", "dev_set", "eval", "test")). organiser zips unpacked when not extracted
patches.why: The repository mounts datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-raw-v4-p as the organisers' files in FF_DATA 00_raw/btc_mavceleb_v4 (train_set.zip, dev_set.zip, meta_file_train_set.csv; configs/data_map.json, no 'exclude'), not as the tree Kaggle had auto-extracted for the original run (log: .../flag2027-raw-v4-p/train_set/train_set/train_set/train_English.txt, no 'unpacking' line). No train list is then found among the extracted inputs, so the verbatim fallback unpack_zips() runs; without this patch it unpacks dev_set.zip too (9 757 members, 989 881 860 bytes zipped) into /kaggle/working/raw. ONLY_UNDER = 'evaluation_phase' kept the dev lists out of the numbers anyway; with the patch the dev archive is never opened. Same text as the patch of stage f47b_screen2 (group 20_features).
patches.effect: none on numbers: train_set.zip is unpacked by the same fallback into /kaggle/working/raw (same train list and media as the auto-extracted copy, other path) and the verbatim last cell removes raw/ (shutil.rmtree(WORKDIR / 'raw')), so the stage output holds no organiser media; the run log shows an 'unpacking .../train_set.zip' line the original log does not have

variant.lora_c1: not used (no ImageBind-audio LoRA in this stage)

dev_data: dev_set.zip of datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-raw-v4-p is mounted (FF_DATA layout: zips, not extracted) but never opened: patch no_dev_zip removes 'dev_set' from ZIP_PREFIXES, so the verbatim fallback unpack_zips() unpacks only train_set.zip (the original run found the train list in Kaggle's auto-extracted tree and unpacked nothing). In addition, ONLY_UNDER = 'evaluation_phase' (code cell 01, set by the kaggle/sat_push.sh sed at push time) skips every organiser list whose path lacks 'evaluation_phase' except train_English.txt, as in the original run. WP-A may also add "exclude": ["dev_set.zip"] to the raw-v4 entry of configs/data_map.json (defence in depth).
